meta.name: supabase
meta.description: Use when doing ANY task involving Supabase. Triggers: Supabase products (Database, Auth, Edge Functions, Realtime, Storage, Vectors, Cron, Queues); client libraries and SSR integrations (supabase-js, @supabase/ssr) in Next.js, React, SvelteKit, Astro, Remix; auth issues (login, logout, sessions, JWT, cookies, getSession, getUser, getClaims, RLS); Supabase CLI or MCP server; schema changes, migrations, declarative schemas, security audits, Postgres extensions (pg_graphql, pg_cron, pg_vector); debugging and troubleshooting errors or unexpected behavior on Supabase projects (HTTP errors, Postgres errors, RLS surprises, permission denied, schema cache issues, timeouts, Edge Function crashes, Realtime drops, Storage failures) and reading or querying logs (Logs Explorer, ClickHouse).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入云端数据库、用户登录与实时数据,排查线上故障
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果用 JS 框架做应用,需要数据库、登录和文件存储后端
copy.tagline_en: Wire database, login and realtime data into your app and debug what breaks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build web apps and need a database, auth, and storage backend

howto.what: 做任何 Supabase 相关的事时,Claude 会先查官方 changelog 和文档再动手,不凭记忆;能改表结构、生成迁移、排查报错与日志,按安全清单检查 RLS,改完跑测试确认。
howto.when: 任何涉及 Supabase 的任务都会触发,例如它的数据库、Auth 等产品或客户端库相关的工作。

say.text: 帮我给 orders 表加一个 status 字段,并生成迁移
say.note: 先查文档,再用 SQL 改并生成迁移文件

say.text: 这个查询被 RLS 挡住了,帮我查原因
say.note: 会先拉调试文档再诊断

say.text: 跑一下安全检查,看我的表有没有 RLS 漏洞

howto.what_en: For any Supabase task, Claude checks the official changelog and docs before acting instead of relying on memory; it changes schemas, generates migrations, debugs errors and logs, reviews RLS security, and verifies fixes with a test query.
howto.when_en: It takes over whenever a task involves Supabase, such as work on its database, Auth and other products, or client libraries.

say_en.text: Add a status column to the orders table and generate a migration
say_en.note: Checks docs first, then changes SQL and creates the migration

say_en.text: This query is blocked by RLS, help me find out why
say_en.note: Fetches the debugging docs before diagnosing

say_en.text: Run a security check for RLS holes in my tables
say_en.note: Walks the security checklist item by item
